definitionZh: 滚动条-gutter CSS属性允许作者为滚动条保留空间,防止随着内容的增长而出现不必要的布局变化,同时避免在不需要滚动时出现不必要的视觉.
sourceDefinition: The scrollbar-gutter CSS property allows authors to reserve space for the scrollbar, preventing unwanted layout changes as the content grows while also avoiding unnecessary visuals when scrolling isn't needed.
